_readBy: scripts/verify.mjs reads the verify/precommit arrays; scripts/release.mjs and scripts/publish-local.mjs read the rest. Underscore keys are notes and are ignored.
_profile: Form not covered by the template: WindRAG has no package.json / pyproject.toml / Cargo.toml / tauri. It is a run-in-place pure-standard-library CLI + static docs site. Closest reference is python-pkg, but it builds no wheel, so releases are text-only (GitHub Release with notes, no packaged artifact).
profile: python-pkg (reference only; not a packaged dist)
_releaseNote: The README measured-figures block and docs/assets/banner.svg are GENERATED from __version__ (single-source rule: never hand-written). release.mjs bumps __version__ only; after a release run `make facts` (gen_readme_facts for both READMEs + generate_banner) and commit the follow-up, otherwise the ci.yml facts --check will flag the one-commit drift. publish.yml is text-only and is not affected by that drift.
_localPublish: Text-only release: empty steps and artifacts means publish-local.mjs only creates/updates the GitHub Release for the tag with notes, attaching no files. The version lives in a regex file (__init__.py), not json/toml, so resolveTag cannot derive it - pass --tag explicitly: `node scripts/publish-local.mjs --tag v1.0.0`.
_mirrorSync: Optional. GitHub is the primary release host; gitee/cnb are download mirrors. Run `node scripts/mirror-sync.mjs` after a release. Tokens come from environment variables only (GITEE_TOKEN / CNB_TOKEN); never hard-code them here. Both remotes are already bound (git remote -v).
